<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Beginning to analyze which shortcodes need proper display processing in OKF.

OKF blog export converts shortcodes to HTML via `blog_shortcodes.py`. Notes export skips this entirely and uses `notes_content.py` instead. Blog exports still contain escaped Hugo syntax like `{{</* notice "tip" */>}}`. Notes bundles contain bible shortcodes in frontmatter assembled by `assemble_markdown`. Now checking which shortcodes appear in notes content and how `notes_content.py` handles them.

Checking actual OKF export output for bible shortcodes. Looking for unprocessed shortcodes in blog posts. Reviewing existing tests for blog_shortcodes. Inspecting the alex-eala tracker for youtube shortcodes.
